1.consolidated_definition: Molusco lamelibranquio marino, de concha gruesa, áspera, de color azul negruzco; su carne es muy apreciada en gastronomía. Ostreidae, Crassostrea rhizophorae.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine lamellibranch mollusk with a thick, rough, dark blue-gray shell; its flesh is highly prized in gastronomy. Ostreidae, Crassostrea rhizophorae.
